items.title: Quran Audio has arrived
items.note: The full Quran is now inside the Empire. Open the Quran section, tap 'Download complete Quran' once while you have data — then listen offline forever, even in deep sleep. Recitations by Mishary Rashid Alafasy and Muhammad Ayyoob.

items.title: Two-tier updates are live
items.note: From now on: MAJOR upgrades (new APK) arrive through Check Updates. MINOR upgrades (news, tips, small fixes) arrive right here — no reinstall, just refresh. The website shows both.
